scope: Exact rational rank/nullspace on entry speed andangle rounded0.1. Bilinear coefficients1,s,angle,s*angle. Blind target means alternative coefficient vectors fit those design rows but differ at reference demand. No claim about noise calibration or all nonlinear athlete models. Priors/regularization can choose a curve but do not make it data-identified.
